schema.description:
A System of Units is a set of Unit Of Measures which can be used to specify anything which can be measured and were historically important, regulated, and defined because of trade and internal commerce.

In a modern System of Unit, some quantities are designated as a fundamental System of Unit, meaning
all other needed Unit Of Measures can be derived from them, whereas in the early and most historic
eras (e.g., Imperial, United States (US) Customary), the units were given by statutory law by the ruling
entities and were not necessarily well inter-related or self-consistent.
